title: COP31 Climate Summit Opens in Turkey Amid Record-Breaking Heat
subtitle: World leaders gather to address global temperature rises and the urgent need for cleaner energy

summary.en: The COP31 climate summit has officially begun in Antalya, Turkey, with nations facing extreme weather challenges. Scientists predict that 2026 will be the hottest year on record due to climate change and El Niño. Negotiators are focusing on electrification and moving away from fossil fuels to address the global energy crisis. While the EU struggles to meet its long-term climate targets, some countries are pushing for a formal treaty to end fossil fuel use. The United States is notably absent from the talks, leaving other nations to lead the difficult discussions.
summary.zh: COP31 氣候峰會已在土耳其安塔利亞正式開幕，各國正面臨極端天氣的挑戰。科學家預測，由於氣候變遷與聖嬰現象，二〇二六年將是有紀錄以來最熱的一年。談判代表正聚焦於電氣化與擺脫化石燃料，以解決全球能源危機。儘管歐盟在達成長期氣候目標上遭遇困難，但部分國家正推動簽署正式條約以終結化石燃料的使用。美國顯著缺席此次會談，使得其他國家必須主導這些艱難的討論。

paragraphs.en: World leaders and climate negotiators have gathered in the seaside city of Antalya, Turkey, for the start of COP31, the latest United Nations climate summit. This year’s meeting comes at a time of extreme environmental pressure, as scientists warn that the planet is on course for its hottest year on record. According to the BBC, researchers at the independent group Berkeley Earth are 95% confident that 2026 will surpass the previous record set in 2024. This trend is driven by the ongoing effects of climate change and a powerful weather pattern known as El Niño, which warms the surface of the ocean and pushes global temperatures higher.
paragraphs.zh: 全球領袖與氣候談判代表已齊聚土耳其海濱城市安塔利亞，參加聯合國氣候變遷大會（COP31）的開幕式。今年的會議召開之際，環境正承受極大壓力，科學家警告地球正邁向有紀錄以來最熱的一年。根據英國廣播公司（BBC）報導，獨立研究機構「柏克萊地球」（Berkeley Earth）的研究人員有百分之九十五的把握，認為二〇二六年將會超越二〇二四年創下的紀錄。這股趨勢是由氣候變遷的持續影響，以及被稱為「聖嬰現象」（El Niño）的強大天氣型態所推動，該現象會使海洋表面升溫，進而拉高全球氣溫。

paragraphs.en: The urgency of the situation was highlighted by the World Meteorological Organization (WMO), which stated that the Earth is heating at an accelerating rate. WMO Secretary-General Celeste Saulo described the current temperature data as being "off the charts." The impact of this warming is already being felt globally. Recent months have seen widespread wildfires across Europe and a tragic glacier collapse in Nepal that resulted in over 1,000 deaths. Experts from the UK Met Office noted that the world is no longer living in the climate of the 20th century, and that these changes will soon affect every aspect of daily life.
paragraphs.zh: 世界氣象組織（WMO）強調了當前局勢的緊迫性，指出地球正以加速的速率變暖。世界氣象組織秘書長索洛（Celeste Saulo）形容目前的氣溫數據已「超出預期」。這種暖化的影響已在全球各地顯現。近幾個月來，歐洲各地發生廣泛的野火，尼泊爾也發生悲劇性的冰川崩塌，造成超過一千人死亡。英國氣象局（UK Met Office）的專家指出，世界已不再處於二十世紀的氣候環境中，這些變化很快就會影響日常生活的各個層面。

paragraphs.en: As the conference begins, the focus has shifted toward practical solutions. While previous summits concentrated primarily on reducing emissions, COP31 is being called the "electrification COP" by many observers. According to NPR, the goal is to increase the global electrification rate from approximately 23% today to 35% by 2035. This shift involves moving toward solar energy, wind power, and electric vehicles. Analysts at the energy think tank Ember suggest that these technologies now offer a cheaper and more secure way to address the global energy crisis, which has been worsened by conflicts and rising oil prices.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著會議展開，焦點已轉向務實的解決方案。雖然過去的峰會主要集中在減少排放，但許多觀察家將 COP31 稱為「電氣化峰會」。根據美國公共廣播電台（NPR）報導，目標是在二〇三五年將全球電氣化率從目前的約百分之二十三提升至百分之三十五。這項轉變涉及轉向太陽能、風力發電與電動車。能源智庫「灰燼」（Ember）的分析師認為，這些技術目前提供了更便宜且更安全的方式來應對全球能源危機，而這場危機已因衝突與油價上漲而惡化。

paragraphs.en: However, the path to these goals remains difficult. A report from the European Environment Agency (EEA) found that while the European Union is close to meeting its 2030 climate targets, its efforts to reduce pollution are not deep enough to reach its 2040 and 2050 goals. The report noted that the EU must cut emissions in the next five years as much as it did over the last two decades to stay on track. Furthermore, some observers worry that the "easy wins" in climate policy have already been achieved, making future progress harder to secure.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，達成這些目標的道路依然艱辛。歐洲環境署（EEA）的一份報告發現，儘管歐盟接近達成二〇三〇年的氣候目標，但其減少污染的努力尚不足以實現二〇四〇年與二〇五〇年的目標。報告指出，歐盟必須在未來五年內削減與過去二十年相當的排放量，才能維持進度。此外，一些觀察家擔心氣候政策中「容易達成的目標」已經實現，這使得未來的進展更難以確保。

paragraphs.en: Disagreements over how to handle fossil fuels also continue to shadow the negotiations. For years, major fossil fuel producers like Saudi Arabia and Russia have opposed including language about phasing out oil, gas, and coal in final agreements. In response, a group of more than 25 nations is working on a legally binding treaty to formally end the use of fossil fuels. Supporters hope that more countries will join this initiative during the two-week summit in Turkey. The UN climate chief, Simon Stiell, reminded delegates that while no single conference can solve every problem, the urgency of the moment must drive nations to take stronger action.
paragraphs.zh: 對於如何處理化石燃料的分歧，也持續籠罩著談判過程。多年來，沙烏地阿拉伯與俄羅斯等主要的化石燃料生產國，一直反對在最終協議中納入關於逐步淘汰石油、天然氣與煤炭的措辭。對此，一個由超過二十五個國家組成的聯盟正致力於制定一項具有法律約束力的條約，以正式終結化石燃料的使用。支持者希望在土耳其為期兩週的峰會期間，能有更多國家加入這項倡議。聯合國氣候變遷執行秘書斯蒂爾（Simon Stiell）提醒與會代表，雖然沒有單一會議能解決所有問題，但當前的緊迫性必須促使各國採取更強有力的行動。

paragraphs.en: The political landscape of the summit is also complicated by the absence of the United States. The U.S. State Department confirmed that it would not be sending a delegation to COP31, following a similar decision last year. Meanwhile, the summit is being co-hosted by Australia, which is leading the formal negotiations. This has led to some criticism, as some observers point out the contradiction of a high-emitting nation that exports fossil fuels being in charge of the talks. Australian officials have defended their position, emphasizing a commitment to protecting the environment for future generations.
paragraphs.zh: 峰會的政治局勢也因美國的缺席而變得複雜。美國國務院證實，繼去年做出類似決定後，今年將不會派遣代表團參加 COP31。與此同時，本次峰會由澳洲共同主辦，並由該國主導正式談判。這引發了一些批評，部分觀察家指出，由一個高排放且出口化石燃料的國家來主持談判存在矛盾。澳洲官員則為其立場辯護，強調致力於為後代子孫保護環境。

paragraphs.en: Young activists are also making their voices heard in Antalya. Janiely Truká, an 18-year-old activist from Brazil, told The Guardian that for Indigenous peoples, the climate crisis is not a distant threat but a daily reality. She explained that her community feels the impact of rising temperatures and unpredictable rainfall, which threaten their traditional ways of life and their connection to the land. As the summit continues, these activists are pushing leaders to recognize that caring for the environment is essential for human survival.
paragraphs.zh: 年輕的行動主義者也在安塔利亞發出他們的聲音。來自巴西的十八歲行動主義者特魯卡（Janiely Truká）告訴《衛報》，對於原住民而言，氣候危機並非遙遠的威脅，而是每日的現實。她解釋說，她的社群感受到了氣溫上升與降雨不可預測帶來的影響，這些變化威脅著他們的傳統生活方式與土地連結。隨著峰會持續進行，這些行動主義者正敦促領袖們體認到，關懷環境對於人類生存至關重要。

paragraphs.en: Ultimately, COP31 faces the difficult task of bridging the gap between scientific warnings and political reality. As the world deals with the economic costs of extreme weather and the instability of energy markets, the pressure on delegates to reach a meaningful agreement is higher than ever. Whether the summit can move beyond promises and toward concrete, global action remains the central question for the coming weeks.
paragraphs.zh: 歸根究柢，COP31 面臨著彌合科學警告與政治現實之間差距的艱鉅任務。隨著世界應對極端天氣帶來的經濟成本與能源市場的不穩定，代表們達成實質協議的壓力比以往任何時候都大。峰會能否超越承諾並邁向具體的全球行動，仍是未來幾週的核心問題。

keyTerms.definitionEn: Likely to achieve or experience something based on current progress.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 朝著某個結果發展，很有可能發生。
keyTerms.noteZh: 字面上是「在航道上」，這裡指預計會發生的趨勢。文中：scientists warn that the planet is on course for its hottest year on record.

keyTerms.definitionEn: Extremely high or beyond the normal range of measurement.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 高得離譜、超出正常範圍。
keyTerms.noteZh: 原意指數據超出圖表範圍，這裡形容氣溫高得異常。文中：WMO Secretary-General Celeste Saulo described the current temperature data as being "off the charts."

keyTerms.definitionEn: To cast doubt on or cause worry about something; to follow and influence negatively.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作名詞（影子），這裡作動詞，形容爭議影響了談判。文中：Disagreements over how to handle fossil fuels also continue to shadow the negotiations.

keyTerms.definitionEn: Goals or tasks that are simple to achieve with little effort.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 輕而易舉的成功、容易達成的目標。
keyTerms.noteZh: 指政策中較容易實施的部分，暗示接下來的挑戰會更困難。文中：Furthermore, some observers worry that the "easy wins" in climate policy have already been achieved, making future progress harder to secure.

quiz.question: According to the article, what is the specific target set for global electrification by 2035?

options.A: To reach a total of 23% electrification.
options.B: To increase the electrification rate to 35%.
options.C: To double the current rate of electrification.
options.D: To eliminate the use of fossil fuels completely.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第三段，NPR 指出 COP31 的目標是將全球電氣化率從目前的約 23% 提升至 2035 年的 35%。選項 A 是目前的數據而非目標；選項 C 錯誤，因為 35% 並非 23% 的兩倍；選項 D 雖然是氣候會議的長期願景，但並非該段落提到的具體 2035 年電氣化目標。

quiz.question: What can be inferred about the European Union's progress toward its climate goals?

options.A: The EU has already successfully achieved its 2050 climate targets.
options.B: The EU is expected to easily meet its 2040 goals without further effort.
options.C: The EU must significantly accelerate its emission reduction pace to meet future targets.
options.D: The EU has decided to abandon its 2030 targets to focus on 2050.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據第四段，EEA 報告指出歐盟雖接近 2030 目標，但要達成 2040 與 2050 目標，必須在未來五年內完成過去二十年的減排量，這暗示了必須大幅加速減排步伐。選項 A 與事實相反；選項 B 錯誤，因為報告明確指出目前的努力深度不足；選項 D 文章並未提及放棄 2030 目標。

quiz.question: In the fifth paragraph, what does the word 'shadow' mean in the phrase 'disagreements... continue to shadow the negotiations'?

options.A: To provide physical protection from the sun.
options.B: To follow someone closely to observe them.
options.C: To cast doubt or cause difficulty for something.
options.D: To represent a dark or hidden secret.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。在此語境中，「shadow」作為動詞，意指這些爭議像陰影般籠罩著談判，為談判過程帶來負面影響或困難。選項 A 是字面意思，不符合語境；選項 B 雖然有跟隨之意，但在此處不符合政治談判的語義；選項 D 的解釋過於牽強，並未捕捉到「造成阻礙」的動態含義。

quiz.question: What is the central theme of the article regarding COP31?

options.A: The success of Australia in leading global climate negotiations.
options.B: The primary role of young activists in changing international law.
options.C: The technical details of how solar and wind energy function.
options.D: The challenge of translating scientific urgency into effective political action.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 D。文章從氣候惡化的科學警告開始，隨後討論了電氣化目標、政治分歧、美國缺席以及環保人士的呼籲，最終在結尾處總結 COP31 面臨的核心任務，即彌合科學警告與政治現實之間的巨大鴻溝。選項 A、B、C 皆僅為文章中的部分細節，不足以代表全文的核心主旨。
